mainEntity.name: What should I do first before tile floor installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start by checking the subfloor, measuring the room, and choosing a tile that fits the space and traffic level. For Denver-area homes, moisture and subfloor condition matter a lot, especially on concrete slabs or over wood subfloors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Check the subfloor, measure carefully, and choose a tile suited to the room and traffic level. In Denver-area homes, moisture and floor condition are key before any tile goes down.
